name: Yamoussoukro
subtitle: Yamoussoukro, capital of Côte d'Ivoire: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: About 340,234 people live in the chef-lieu of Yamoussoukro (counted 2021).
The Autonomous District of Yamoussoukro covers 2,132 km2, 0.7% of the national territory.
At the 2021 census (RGPH 2021) the Autonomous District of Yamoussoukro had 422,072 inhabitants, of whom 340,234 in the chef-lieu (city).

parts.text: The Autonomous District of Yamoussoukro covers 2,132 km2, 0.7% of the national territory.
At the 2021 census (RGPH 2021) the Autonomous District of Yamoussoukro had 422,072 inhabitants, of whom 340,234 in the chef-lieu (city).
The Ministry of the Economy describes Yamoussoukro as chef-lieu of the Autonomous District and political and administrative capital of Côte d'Ivoire.
The Ministry of the Economy describes Yamoussoukro as a training hub for Ivorian youth in particular and francophone Africa in general.
Yamoussoukro has one industrial zone of 750 ha, of which 250 ha are used, with 24 active companies (MCIPPME, 2022).
The district has eight commercial banks, the Treasury bank and six microfinance structures.
The administrator Simon Maurice renamed the village of N'Gokro Yamoussoukro in honour of Queen Yamoussou; the suffix "kro" means village in Baoulé.
In 1983 Ivory Coast's National Assembly voted to transfer the capital to Yamoussoukro, President Houphouët-Boigny's birthplace, as "a tribute from a grateful nation to a widely respected leader".
An academic study says that although Yamoussoukro has been the political and administrative capital since 21 March 1983, it is still awaiting the transfer of state institutions.
The same study argues that the effective transfer is hindered by a lack of political will and by a land question.
The ten artificial lakes of Yamoussoukro were created in 1966 on the initiative and funding of President Houphouët-Boigny.
Yamoussoukro is where the village of Houphouët, N'Gokro, stood, and it became the political capital of the country.

parts.text: 340,234 in 2021, according to the figures compiled from the national statistics office. Which area is counted matters: Yamoussoukro chef-lieu (city) within the Département and Autonomous District of Yamoussoukro, RGPH 2021 (INS/ANStat); the district as a whole had 422,072.

items.text: Queen Yamoussou led the village of N'Gokro at the time of French colonisation.
The ten artificial lakes of Yamoussoukro were created.
Yamoussoukro became the political and administrative capital of Côte d'Ivoire.
Pope John Paul II laid the first stone of the Basilica of Our Lady of Peace.
The basilica was built by 24 national and international companies.
Pope John Paul II consecrated the basilica.
The headquarters of the Fondation Félix Houphouët-Boigny pour la Recherche de la Paix was inaugurated by the symbolic handing over of keys to the UNESCO Director-General.
The RGPH 2021 census counted 422,072 inhabitants in the Autonomous District of Yamoussoukro.
